title: Filtration of a constructible sheaf by extensions by zero of lisse sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, and $F\in\Cons(X,\Lambda)$. Let
$S_1,\dots,S_m$ be a stratification adapted to $F$, ordered as in
[det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification] (1), so that $V_k=S_1\cup\dots\cup S_k$ is
open, with open immersions $v_k\colon V_k\hookrightarrow X$, and let $a_k\colon S_k\hookrightarrow X$.
Put $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F\subseteq F$. Then
$$
0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq F_m=F,\qquad F_k/F_{k-1}\cong a_{k!}(F|_{S_k}),
$$
and each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse.
Here $V_0=\varnothing$, and lisse means locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology. The category $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$ is the category of constructible $\Lambda_X$-modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For a locally closed immersion $a\colon S\hookrightarrow X$, write $a=i\circ u$, where $u\colon S\hookrightarrow\overline S$ is open and $i\colon\overline S\hookrightarrow X$ is closed, and define $a_!=i_*u_!$. The inclusions in the filtration need not be strict.

proof.text: Use the already proved monic condensed open counit and zero/identity endpoint lemmas in ContinuousConstructibleIntegralGluing. From hV the first open is empty, the last is all of X, and adjacent prefix opens are nested. Compose the two actual open adjunctions and use Adjunction.exists_iso_counit_app with upperStarComp to factor their counits over F. Hence their image subobjects are nested. A module on the empty scheme is zero, giving the bottom endpoint, and the full-open counit is invertible, giving the top endpoint.

Partition disjointness and hV identify the difference of adjacent prefix opens with the designated stratum. Factor its immersion through the larger open and prove the factor is closed from its range. The proved condensed open_cokernel_zero and supported_unit identify the local localization cokernel with closed direct image of its closed restriction; closed_cokernel_iso identifies this restriction with the original module restriction. Apply coefficientHeart_filtration_core only to compare this closed-then-open extension with the scheme-theoretic-image extension. Subobject.cokernelOfLEMkIso and preservation of cokernels by outer open extension identify the original quotient with the local cokernel. Explicit imageSubobject_mono equalities transport between image and represented subobjects.
